entities.name: PMID:25098709
observations: Nakajima et al., Oral Diseases 2015;21(3):328-334. DOI:10.1111/odi.12280.
Rat dental pulp cells treated with AGE showed increased S100A8 and S100A9 mRNA by real-time PCR; anti-RAGE antibody prevented these increases.
PD98059 inhibited AGE-induced S100A8 increase; SB203580 inhibited AGE-induced S100A9 increase. Abstract conclusion: responses may involve RAGE-MAPK signaling.

entities.name: AGE induces S100A8/A9 mRNA
observations: In cultured rat dental pulp cells, AGE increased S100A8 and S100A9 mRNA; anti-RAGE antibody prevented both responses. PMID:25098709.
PD98059 inhibited the S100A8 increase and SB203580 inhibited the S100A9 increase, supporting involvement of MEK/ERK and p38 arms, respectively. PMID:25098709.
The abstract reports mRNA, not protein-level expression, and does not by itself establish all signaling steps definitively.
